newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grange reports high copper grades.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grange reports high copper grades.

text.p: Mineral explorer Grange Resources NL said on Tuesday it had received encouraging results from the Highway and Reward projects at the Mt Windsor joint venture in Queensland.

Grange said the joint venture manager, RGC Ltd, had reported high grade intersections of copper mineralisation with the most significant being 53.5 metres at 16.4 percent copper and 0.6 grammes per tonne (g/t) gold from 102 metres.
Grange said the results confirmed the continuity of high grade mineralisation reported previously at the Reward project.
